context_for_next_testing_agent: The sign-in form is INLINE on protected pages (no /login route); use the on-page email/password inputs and the 'Sign in' text button. Switching users in Playwright requires either a fresh browser context (page.context.clear_cookies()+page.reload may still leave the SPA session) or ending the previous session via UI. Live /api/routing/trials/{id} returns candidate.tasks[] but /api/routing/trials?role=... deliberately omits tasks. ARMI agent lookup uses 'agent_id' key; after adoption the planner llm agent is 'llm:planner:<adopted-model>' with admission.decision starting with 'measured routing trial'. Always finish with POST /api/routing/revert {role:'planner'} then POST /api/armi/sync.
